runs.draft: The firm is evaluating a proposed Series A investment of up to $7 million in Shopify, a profitable, largely bootstrapped SaaS provider of e-commerce software for SMBs. The portfolio company thesis centers on strong organic growth, attractive unit economics, and exposure to the consumerization of enterprise software and continued e-commerce penetration among SMBs.
